data.name: Aurule Dynasty
data.detailed_description:
Explore an interconnected open-world adventure reminiscent of the very first Zelda title, filled with challenging dungeons and formidable bosses. Aurule Dynasty blends nostalgic pixel art graphics with innovative modern gameplay mechanics, providing a fresh yet familiar gaming experience.

As the last knight of the Kingdom of Aurule, you receive a telepathic plea from the Princess, urging you to stop a coup d'etat orchestrated by the treacherous royal vizier. Embark on an epic quest across the four diverse regions of Aurule, each with its own unique challenges and lore.

Every new item you acquire unlocks further exploration opportunities, allowing you to delve deeper into this Metroidvania-inspired world. Uncover the bloody history of Aurule and restore order to the kingdom.

Join the adventure and become the hero Aurule desperately needs. Wishlist now and prepare for an unforgettable journey!
